points.label: A recipe is a versioned layout module.
points.text: tools/recipes/nutrition.mjs exports name = 'nutrition' and version = '4.0.0'. It validates the fixture and builds the scene.

points.label: Published versions are pinned by hash.
points.text: tools/catalog.sql records slug@semver and the SHA-256 of every declared file. node tools/catalog.mjs verify fails on any drift.

points.label: A change ships as a new version.
points.text: Published rows are immutable, so past renders stay reproducible. Every receipt records the recipe version and verified: true or false.

points.label: The fixture is data, never code.
points.text: Schema-validated: unknown fields, code and remote assets are refused. A layout that does not fit is rejected, not shipped.

ledger.label: ACTIVE RECIPES IN tools/catalog.sql
ledger.note: From node tools/catalog.mjs show <slug> --json on 2026-10-29. Older versions stay in the ledger as history.
